title: Llama waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#f5e6c8"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="80" width="5" height="14" rx="2" fill="#e8d5b0"/>
  <rect x="46" y="82" width="5" height="13" rx="2" fill="#e8d5b0"/>
  <rect x="56" y="82" width="5" height="13" rx="2" fill="#e8d5b0"/>
  <rect x="66" y="80" width="5" height="14" rx="2" fill="#e8d5b0"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x="55" y="38" width="14" height="34" rx="7" fill="#f5e6c8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="34" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#f5e6c8"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="53" cy="24" rx="4" ry="7" fill="#f0dbb8" transform="rotate(-15 53 24)"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="24" rx="4" ry="7" fill="#f0dbb8" transform="rotate(15 75 24)"/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx="53" cy="24" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#e8a0a0" transform="rotate(-15 53 24)"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="24" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#e8a0a0" transform="rotate(15 75 24)"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="38" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#f0dbb8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="32" r="2.2" fill="#5a4a3a"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="32" r="2.2" fill="#5a4a3a"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="60.8" cy="31.2" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="71.8" cy="31.2" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="37" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#d4a0a0"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M69 41 Q72 43 75 41" stroke="#c08080" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d="M33 62 Q20 48 18 38" stroke="#f5e6c8" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- hand/hoof -->
  <ellipse cx="18" cy="36" rx="4.5" ry="4" fill="#e8d5b0"/>
  <!-- other front leg/arm -->
  <path d="M38 68 Q32 78 30 88" stroke="#f5e6c8" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="88" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#e8d5b0"/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d="M64 74 Q68 84 66 92" stroke="#f5e6c8" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="92" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#e8d5b0"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx="27" cy="70" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#f0dbb8"/>
  <!-- fluff details -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="60" r="4" fill="#f0dbb8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="64" r="3.5" fill="#f0dbb8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="36" r="2" fill="#f0dbb8" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="33" r="1.5" fill="#f0dbb8" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
